annotations.title: Work out how long you can afford to test a career change

description: Works out how many months someone can afford to spend testing or making a career change, from their own numbers, e.g. 'can I afford to quit my job', 'how long can I last without a salary', 'I have 12,000 saved and spend 2,500 a month, how long do I have to change careers', 'how much runway do I need before I retrain', 'my severance is 20,000, how long before I need a job', 'can I afford to go part-time to study'. Takes savings or severance, essential monthly costs, any monthly income that continues, any one-off spend such as a course, and how many months of costs to keep untouched. Returns the number of months covered, the monthly gap, and a testing plan sized to that time. Pure arithmetic on the numbers given: it works in any currency, stores nothing, and is not financial advice.

buffer_months.description: Months of costs to keep untouched as a safety buffer (default 1).

monthly_costs.description: Essential monthly costs: housing, food, bills and debt repayments. A plain number in the person's own currency.

monthly_income.description: Money that would still come in each month: a job kept, part-time work, benefits or a partner's share. 0 if none. A plain number in the person's own currency.

one_off_costs.description: One-off spending on the change, such as a course or tools. 0 if none. A plain number in the person's own currency.

savings.description: Money they could draw on: savings, severance or a payout. A plain number in the person's own currency.

name: plan_career_change_runway

guide_url.description: OffLadder's guide and calculator on affording a career change.

monthly_gap.description: Costs minus income each month; 0 when income covers costs.

months.description: Months of testing the money covers, rounded down to half months; null when income covers costs.

plan.description: A testing plan sized to the runway.

usable.description: What is left to spend after the one-off costs and the buffer.

title: Work out how long you can afford to test a career change
